title: Other contributed tunes and Golden Crest
summary: He cannot name other tunes, played from love of music, and wrote Golden Crest as his own concert piece.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Were there any other tunes -- I'm sure there were because you've mentioned a couple -- but what other tunes was your music incorparated into?
Oh, I don't remember because we were

always running up there, playing some melody or some phrases, and, you know, that was the end of it. We'd just do it out of just love for music. We didn't think too much about commercializing on what we did.
Oh, "Golden Crest" was -- I got tired of playing certain tunes for the concerts, so I just told him I'm going to write my own tune for this concert, and that was "Golden Crest".
Did you get (inaudible) on that? I don't remember.
I -- I think I got a part somewhere, but I never get anything from it, so I never pay any attention.
